retainedReference.title: Castel Sant Angelo, keep and connected fortifications

pictures.author: John Samuel (Jsamwrites)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1280px front oblique: warm brick cylinder, pale horizontal courses and dense supporting corbel band, upper loggia/flat terraces/rooms and crenellated roof tower, green winged figure on pedestal. Lower brick curtain/bastion and battlements, distant tower/capped pavilion. Bridge/riverside wall/pines/people remain context.

pictures.author: Kiss Tamas (Kit36a)
pictures.observed: Actually viewed1024px broad river elevation: complete circular keep/upper stacked rooms/winged roof figure; low curtain/ramparts/merlons and river-side round corner structure. Independent Ponte Sant Angelo/river/trees visible. This is a river-side ground photograph, not an aerial; map parts guide unseen court/roof layout.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Connected Castel Sant Angelo exterior from the original map parent and180 height-tagged building parts: pale masonry base, large brick circular keep and upper galleries/terraces, four corner bastions/curtain walls/battlements, mapped upper rooms/courts, stepped ascent and a real arched south entrance recess/threshold. Original faceted winged roof figure and pedestal are a schematic silhouette. Preserve open ground courtyards, bridge, river and independent Passetto corridor/neighbors. No furnished museum/chambers, copied coats of arms/lettering, crowds, flags or bridge statuary.
